messages:
elaine_cs: Quick kickoff for Zephyr (RetailX) onboarding — want to align stakeholders, success metrics, and a 30/60/90 timeline. @alejandro_pm @devon_se @mark_success can you confirm availability for a 30m sync tomorrow? Key risks: SSO cert timing, product catalog schema mismatch, and training schedule.

devon_se: Available 10:00–11:00 PT. Can do 10:15. Will need API key + sandbox and an example catalog schema.

alejandro_pm: I can do 10:15. I'll bring product roadmap and cc'd Maya (onboarding PM). Proposed success criteria (draft): 1) integration + smoke tests pass, 2) initial search latency <300ms under expected burst, 3) training prompts for top intents delivered week 2.

mark_success: +1 on 10:15. Suggest health cadence: weekly check-ins for month 1 -> then biweekly. Enablement plan: dev workshop in week 2, customer enablement call week 3, and 1:1 with Eng leads during week 1. I'll prepare an onboarding checklist.

sara_ops: Heads-up: procurement timeline is tight — legal needs contract signed by day 45 to avoid renewal-risk exposure. Also SSO certs require a 2-week lead time from vendor side.

onboard-bot: Playbook created: https://playbooks.redwood/zephyr-onboarding. Checklist added and owners can be assigned there.

elaine_cs: Thanks. I'll schedule 30m tomorrow 10:15 PT. Agenda: 1) Stakeholders + roles (10m), 2) Integration plan & blockers (10m), 3) Risks & mitigations + action owners (10m).

devon_se: Can someone upload a sample catalog schema (fields, types, cardinality)? I need it to scope mapping work and data validation.

alejandro_pm: Uploaded schema: https://drive.google/zephyr-schema (dev view). Added a small test dataset and temporary token: test_key_123 (for staging only).

mark_success: Refining success criteria: M0: account activated + API access; M1 (week 2): integration smoke tests passing; M2 (week 4): >50 active users and 1st-week satisfaction >= 80%; M3 (month 2): trained prompts for top 20 intents with precision>0.8.

sara_ops: I'll add procurement owner & milestone dates to the playbook. Also tagging legal contact: legal@retailx.com — they prefer doc review windows on Tuesdays.

elaine_cs: Quick poll for post-kickoff deliverable: reply with 'one-pager' or 'runbook' — preferred?

alejandro_pm: runbook

devon_se: one-pager

mark_success: one-pager + link to runbook (would use both)

sara_ops: runbook

elaine_cs: OK — we'll produce a concise one-pager summary plus a full runbook linked from the playbook. I'll capture action items and owners after the meeting and post the follow-up.

mark_success: Assigned owners in the playbook: devon_se = integration lead, alejandro_pm = product owner, maya_pm = onboarding PM, mark_success = CS lead, sara_ops = procurement/ops.

elaine_cs: Perfect. Thanks everyone — will send calendar invite and pre-read (schema + goals) today. Please add any other blockers in the playbook before the meeting. :thumbsup:
